text:
sasha: Heads-up — customer cust-acme-42 says their Rate summary panel is completely empty but they're getting 429s on API. Can someone look?

kevin: Do we have sample request_ids / timestamps from the customer? Which region?

sasha: They pasted one: request_id=rq_0a1b2c3d region=us-west-2 time=2026-03-16T14:33:04Z. Said console shows 0 tokens for the tenant for the whole hour.

omar: I pulled enforcer logs for cust-acme-42 around that time — enforcement service returning 429s as expected. Example: 
```
[14:33:04Z] enforcer INFO req=rq_0a1b2c3d tenant=cust-acme-42 route=/v1/complete status=429 reason=rate_limit
```
But metrics ingestion shows zero events for that tenant.

infra-bot: kafka-consumer ALERT topic="quota-telemetry" group="metrics-ingest" rebalances=1 last_restart="2026-03-16T14:30:12Z"

luis: Consumer restarted around 14:30 but lag is zero now. Possible that messages are being emitted without tenant metadata and get dropped by writer. Any recent changes to header parsing?

jen: Can we repro in staging quickly? Steps I propose: 1) curl to a test key pinned to a staging tenant, 2) flood until we see 429s from enforcer, 3) watch metrics-writer logs + console panel refresh.

omar: Did staging run. Enforcement produced 429s, writer emitted an exception: 
```
2026-03-16T14:31:09Z metrics-writer ERROR: NullPointerException while extracting tenant_id from telemetry event, event.id=evt_7f8e9d
java.lang.NullPointerException: tenant_id
  at com.redwood.metrics.Writer.extractTenant(Writer.java:214)
  at com.redwood.metrics.Writer.apply(Writer.java:98)
```
Events with missing tenant_id are being skipped rather than recorded.

kevin: That matches our prod symptom. I remember PR #548 touched auth header parsing last week, renaming header X-Customer -> X-Cust in the auth service. If the metrics pipeline still expects X-Customer it would drop tenant_id. Link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pulls/548

luis: Good catch. Metrics-writer should accept both headers. Is this a recent deploy to prod?

omar: Auth change was deployed 2026-03-16T14:25Z in us-west-2. That lines up with timeline.

sasha: Plan: 1) push hotfix to metrics-writer to fallback to X-Cust header if X-Customer missing, 2) reingest the 14:20–14:40 window from telemetry archive, 3) notify customer and close ticket.

kevin: I opened a patch branch and bumped version. Hotfix adds header fallback and a defensive null check. CI running now.

jen: I kicked off reingest job for that time window: job_id=ri-20260316-1420-1440.

infra-bot: deploy-bot INFO deploy started: service=metrics-writer env=prod region=us-west-2 version=2026.3.16-hotfix-1

omar: Deployed hotfix to us-west-2 at 14:45Z, metrics-writer logs now show tenant extraction success for previously failing events. Example:
```
[14:46:12Z] metrics-writer INFO tenant=cust-acme-42 event=evt_7f8e9d persisted=true
```

luis: Reingest job completed 14:58Z, dashboard started backfilling. Customer confirmed they now see usage for the hour and 429s correspond to the displayed counts.

sasha: Customer reported resolved. Thanks team. Action items: postmortem, add unit test for header variants, add an alert if metrics writer drops >0% of events, and put a small canary around auth header changes.

jen: I'll file the postmortem and add tests. @oncall-bot can you mark the incident closed?

oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-2026-1234 closed. Duration: 18m. Response runbook used: metrics-backfill -> hotfix.

kevin: :thumbsup: I'll also add a quick integration test in the deploy pipeline to prevent header regressions.

sasha: Great. Closing thread — tagging @support to follow up with customer for a formal update.
